brief_messages.message: Submit expense reports within 30 days of the purchase
brief_messages.behavior: File each expense inside 30 days instead of batching them at quarter end
brief_messages.common_misrecall: The old 90-day window, or a made-up number like 60 days

brief_messages.message: Snap the receipt in the Navan app at the point of sale, never email it
brief_messages.behavior: Photograph the receipt in the app when paying, instead of emailing receipts to accounting
brief_messages.common_misrecall: Emailing receipts to Denise in accounting, the old process

brief_messages.message: Anything over $250 needs manager pre-approval before you buy
brief_messages.behavior: Get a manager's approval in the app before any purchase over $250
brief_messages.common_misrecall: The old $500 threshold, or approval after the purchase instead of before

consent.purpose: to check whether the song's message landed; the recording is scored, summarized for the company, and never used to clone a voice
consent.withdrawal: say 'stop' at any point, or tell the company to delete the recording; the check-in ends and nothing is kept

answers.question: In your own words, what did the song ask you to do differently?
answers.transcript:
Um, honestly the chorus is stuck in my head.
30 days.
30 days.
And no more emailing receipts to Denise.
It all goes in the app now.

answers.question: Say you bought a three hundred dollar part tomorrow. Walk me through exactly what you'd do.
answers.transcript:
Anything over 500 I'd get approved first.
300 is under that so I'd just buy it and log the receipt in the app.

per_message.evidence_quote: no more emailing receipts to Denise. It all goes in the app now.
per_message.note: Correctly names app capture over emailing, though app name unstated.

per_message.evidence_quote: Anything over 500 I'd get approved first. 300 is under that so I'd just buy it
per_message.note: Confidently uses the old $500 threshold and would skip pre-approval on a $300 buy.

recall.what_they_would_actually_do: They'd file within 30 days and snap receipts in the app, but buy a $300 part without manager pre-approval because they still believe the threshold is $500.
